familial-debt-bond.name: Familial Debt-Bond
familial-debt-bond.description:
Debts unpaid by one generation are passed to the next. Working to pay them off is seen as something to be proud of. What choice do they have?

Obtained from Bounties in the Orb Vallis (Venus), or purchased from Ticker in Fortuna (Venus).

father-token.name: Father Token
father-token.description:
A symbol of Father's trust and confidence.

Obtained from Father in the Necralisk on Deimos.

ferros.name: Ferros
ferros.description:
A resilient metal that is hardened by impurities within.

Location: Plains of Eidolon (Earth) from Red Mining Veins and Thumpers

fieldron.name: Fieldron
fieldron.description:
ClanTech weaponized containment field to contain superheated substances.

Location: Clan Research (Energy Lab in the Dojo) and Corpus Invasion Rewards

fieldron-sample.name: Fieldron Sample
fieldron-sample.description:
This destroyed Fieldron could further research into super-heated containment fields.

Location: Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Europa, Neptune, and Pluto

flawless-sentient-core.name: Flawless Sentient Core
flawless-sentient-core.description:
A Sentient Core of this quality and condition has rarely been found. Truly a special specimen.

Location: Earned by capturing Eidolons found roaming the Plains of Eidolon on Earth at night

fresnels.name: Fresnels
fresnels.description: A rare Orokin material used to create a tear in space and allow safe passage through the Void.

frostcap.name: Frostcap
frostcap.description: Engineered by the Orokin to convert airborne chemicals into breathable air.

frostleaf.name: Frostleaf
frostleaf.description:
This resilient plant provides a natural food source in frigid areas of the Origin system. 

Location: Obtained by gathering Frostleaf plants that grow on Venus, Neptune, and Pluto
